programs.title: Operation: FLIGHT
programs.desc: Documentarians present the behind-the-scenes work of Warsaw's Chopin Airport and LOT Polish Airlines.Together with the cameras, they will reach places where until now only staff members had access.The airport is a place where you cannot afford to make mistakes.Extraordinary safety requirements make each process equally important and extremely interesting.Viewers can finally see, among others:who supervises air traffic and how, what happens to luggage left before check-in, and how flight attendants prepare for each flight.Everything related to the operation of an airport requires perfect operation and planning.PLL LOT transports almost five million passengers annually.

programs.title: Follow Donal... to Europe 2
programs.desc: Viewers will go on a journey with young Donal Skehan as he travels across Europe to expand his culinary horizons.After a successful trip to Vietnam, the chef is looking for more home-made delicacies.In Budapest, he tries delicious street food, then visits the annual gourmet festival, full of famous and exquisite flavors.During his visit to Istanbul, Donal will be treated to a truly royal breakfast, followed by a sheep's head stew.The trail will then take him to Amsterdam, Lisbon, Krakow and Stockholm, where he will visit the most interesting places, filled to the brim with exciting flavors and aromas.A new culinary adventure, new, authentic scents and spices awaits around every corner.
